import json, random, subprocess, importlib.util, importlib.machinery, time
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_loader('sub', importlib.machinery.SourceFileLoader('sub', '/app/submit/run'))
sub = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(sub)
rng = random.Random(7)
fib=[]
for i in range(512):
    a = (i << 117) | rng.getrandbits(117)
    fib.append({'prefix': sub.fmt_prefix(a,128), 'hop': i % 65536})
med = json.dumps({"op":"compile","fib":fib,"capacities":[1000000000]*8,"max_stride":16})
p = subprocess.run(['/app/submit/run'], input=(med+'\n').encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
img = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
lines = [med]*100
for i in range(100):
    lines.append(json.dumps({"op":"lookup","image":img,"addresses":[sub.fmt_addr(rng.getrandbits(128)) for _ in range(100)]}))
data = '\n'.join(lines)+'\n'
print('input bytes', len(data))
t=time.time()
p = subprocess.run(['/app/submit/run'], input=data.encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
print('time %.2f'%(time.time()-t), 'rc', p.returncode)
res = [json.loads(l) for l in p.stdout.decode().splitlines()]
print('responses', len(res))
bad = [(i, r.get('status')) for i, r in enumerate(res) if r.get('status') != 'ok']
print('non-ok:', bad[:10], 'count', len(bad))
print('stderr tail:', p.stderr.decode()[-1500:])
EOF
